stories.title: Clippers 'Fine' With Kawhi Staying If Trade Voided — Board of Governors Meeting Imminent
stories.angle: Clippers reportedly comfortable with Kawhi returning if NBA voids Raptors trade; BOG meeting in September is key inflection point; Kawhi and Raptors still operating as if trade goes through

x_posts.text:

One meeting. Everything on the line. #NBA #LAClippers

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
11 months. Kawhi personally cleared. Clippers face sanctions.

The NBA Board of Governors meets this September — and that's when the Kawhi Leonard saga finally ends.

Toronto camp Sept 28. The clock is ticking. #NBA #Raptors

facebook.long_form:
The Kawhi Leonard trade saga just took another unexpected turn — and this one could change everything.

According to reports, the Los Angeles Clippers are reportedly "fine" with Kawhi Leonard returning to the team if the NBA ultimately voids his agreed-upon trade to the Toronto Raptors.

Let that sink in.

The trade — which would send Leonard back to Toronto in exchange for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks (2031, 2033), a 2027 pick swap, and additional draft assets — was agreed upon on June 30. But it was put on hold on July 9 when the NBA launched a full investigation into whether the Clippers used an endorsement deal with now-bankrupt California digital bank Aspiration to pay Leonard off-cap.

That investigation has now been running 11 months. Kawhi Leonard has been personally cleared. The Clippers still face potential sanctions — fines, draft pick forfeiture, or potentially worse. And because salary cap circumvention violates the CBA, Commissioner Silver cannot simply act alone.

That is where September's Board of Governors meeting comes in. It is being described as the key inflection point — the moment when the league's ownership group weighs in on sanctions and, by extension, the fate of the trade.

So here is where things stand on September 1:
→ Kawhi Leonard and the Raptors are still operating as if the trade will go through.
→ Toronto's training camp opens September 28 in Quebec City.
→ The Clippers are reportedly comfortable if Kawhi stays — and who could blame them?

One meeting. Three possible outcomes. The answer is coming soon.
facebook.image_caption: 🏀 The Kawhi Leonard saga is almost over. A September Board of Governors meeting could send him to Toronto — or keep him in LA. 11 months. One decision. #NBA #KawhiLeonard #Raptors #LAClippers

stories.title: Steph Curry Fired Up for 2026-27 Warriors — Moses Moody, Jimmy Butler Health Key
stories.angle: Curry expresses genuine excitement for 2026-27; keys are health of Moody and Butler returning from long-term injuries; Warriors open vs. Lakers Oct. 21

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Steph Curry will earn $62.6M in 2026-27 — the first player EVER to make $60M+ in a single season.

And he says he's excited. Moody and Butler returning from injuries give GS a real shot.

Never count out No. 30. #Warriors #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Curry on the 2026-27 Warriors: "There's a lot of health coming back."

Moses Moody. Jimmy Butler. A $62.6M Steph.

Golden State opens Oct. 21 vs. the Lakers. The Dubs might surprise people. #Warriors

facebook.long_form:
Steph Curry just made history — and the season hasn't even started yet.

The Golden State Warriors legend signed a one-year, $62.6 million extension on August 29, the first day the extension window opened. The deal makes Curry the first player in NBA history to earn more than $60 million in a single season. At 38 years old and entering his 18th year as a Warrior, Curry is still setting records in every direction.

But it is not just the money that has Warriors fans excited. Curry himself is genuinely fired up about what is coming.

"There's a lot of health coming back," Curry said, referencing the returns of Moses Moody and Jimmy Butler — two players whose injuries derailed Golden State's 2025-26 campaign and kept the Warriors out of the playoffs entirely.

With Moody and Butler healthy, plus Curry operating at what most analysts still call an elite level, the Warriors could be a far more dangerous team than their playoff-absent 2025-26 suggested. Golden State opens the season on October 21 against the Los Angeles Lakers at Chase Center — a marquee opener that will give fans their first look at this rebuilt roster.

Curry has never played for another franchise. He has never wanted to. And if his excitement is any indication, Golden State is ready to remind the league exactly why you do not count out No. 30.
facebook.image_caption: 💛 $62.6 million. 18 seasons. One franchise. Steph Curry is locked in for 2026-27 — and he says the Warriors are coming back stronger. Moses Moody. Jimmy Butler. Full health. Don't sleep on Golden State. #Warriors #NBA #StephCurry

article.headline: Steph Curry Is Fired Up for 2026-27 — And the Warriors May Be Better Than Anyone Expects

stories.title: 28 Days to NBA Training Camp — Kings Hunting Backup PG After Westbrook Retirement
stories.angle: 28 days to camp; Kings need veteran PG after Westbrook retired; Hornets need 2+ roster moves; most rosters finalized

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
28 days until NBA training camp opens.

Sacramento still needs a veteran PG after Russell Westbrook retired. Darius Acuff Jr. is the man — who backs him up?

Rosters are almost set. Almost. #NBA #NBATrainingCamp

facebook.long_form:
Twenty-eight days.

That is all that stands between NBA fans and the 2026-27 season getting real. Veterans are eligible to report to their teams on September 28, with full training camps opening September 29 and preseason action beginning October 3.

Most rosters are set — but a few teams still have work to do.

The Sacramento Kings are one of them. With Russell Westbrook officially retired, Sacramento needs a veteran backup point guard to support second-year starter Darius Acuff Jr. The Kings have been searching for the right fit all summer, but as of September 1, that spot remains open.

The Charlotte Hornets also need to make at least two additional roster moves before the final roster deadline. Charlotte has been filling its training camp roster with developmental players and Exhibit 10 contracts, hoping a few guys play their way into standard deals during the preseason.

For everyone else, it is about chemistry, conditioning, and health. After a summer of blockbuster moves — Giannis to Miami, Kawhi's saga, Curry's historic extension — October 20 Opening Night cannot get here fast enough.

28 days, Hoop Heroes fam. The wait is almost over.
facebook.image_caption: 🏀 28 days until NBA training camp. The Kings need a backup point guard. The Hornets need to trim their roster. And everywhere else? It's time to get ready. #NBA #NBATrainingCamp

article.headline: 28 Days to NBA Training Camp — The Sacramento Kings Are Still Hunting for a Backup Point Guard

stories.title: NBA Opening Night Oct. 20 — Knicks Championship Banner Night, LeBron's MSG Debut
stories.angle: First-ever NBC tripleheader; Knicks raise first banner since 1973 vs. LeBron James Sixers debut at MSG; OKC vs. SA WCF rematch nightcap

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
NBA Opening Night is Oct. 20. The Knicks raise their FIRST banner since 1973 — then face LeBron James in a Sixers uniform at MSG.

NBC. 7 PM ET. Three games. One unforgettable night.

#NBA #Knicks #OpeningNight

facebook.long_form:
Circle October 20 on your calendar. What the NBA has planned for Opening Night 2026-27 is unlike anything the league has ever done.

For the first time in history, a single broadcast network will air three NBA Tip-Off games in one night. NBC will carry the entire tripleheader — with every game also streaming on Peacock.

Here is the schedule:
🏀 3:00 PM ET — Boston Celtics at Detroit Pistons
🏀 7:00 PM ET — Philadelphia 76ers at New York Knicks (MSG)
🏀 9:30 PM ET — Oklahoma City Thunder vs. San Antonio Spurs

The centerpiece is that 7:00 PM game at Madison Square Garden.

The New York Knicks will raise their first championship banner since 1973 before tip-off — the culmination of a journey that galvanized an entire city. And waiting on the other side of the court? LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, making their Philadelphia 76ers debuts at the most hostile venue in basketball.

The Oklahoma City vs. San Antonio nightcap is a rematch of last season's Western Conference Finals. The Spurs won that series on the way to the NBA Finals, and OKC is ready to prove the result was a fluke. If this is what Opening Night looks like in 2026-27, basketball is in a very good place.
facebook.image_caption: 🗽 Opening Night. October 20. NBC. Knicks raise their FIRST banner since 1973 — then face LeBron James at MSG. Three games. One unforgettable night. #NBA #Knicks #OpeningNight #LeBronJames

article.headline: NBA Opening Night on October 20 Will Be Unlike Anything the League Has Done Before

stories.title: France 7-1 and Rolling — Wemby's FIBA World Cup 2027 Dream in Focus
stories.angle: France 7-1 in Group L after 84-69 Sweden win; Wemby as captain building toward FIBA World Cup qualification; looking forward to remaining windows

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Victor Wembanyama and France are 7-1 in FIBA World Cup qualifying.

After routing Sweden 84-69 — in front of a Swedish all-time basketball record crowd of 14,750 — the World Cup path is real.

Captain Wemby is locked in. #FIBA #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Victor Wembanyama just demolished a Swedish basketball record — and France's World Cup dream is looking very, very real.

On August 30, France crushed Sweden 84-69 at Avicii Arena in Stockholm. The 14,750 fans in attendance set an all-time record for a basketball game in Sweden. France did not care about the crowd noise. Wembanyama — named France's captain for this FIBA World Cup 2027 European Qualifying window — was absolutely dominant: 18 points, 8 rebounds, 3 blocked shots, and 6-of-7 from the field.

Sweden's Pelle Larsson did everything he could with 23 points, and the home crowd kept Sweden in it. They even led 65-64 with five minutes left. But Wemby and France pulled away for good.

The result pushes France to 7-1 in Group L qualifying — a position that puts a 2027 World Cup berth squarely within reach.

This is the first time Wembanyama has been back with the national team since the 2024 Paris Olympics, and he is making up for lost time. Coming off a historic 2025-26 NBA season (25.0 ppg / 11.5 rpg / 3.1 bpg, unanimous DPOY, Spurs to the NBA Finals), Wemby is operating on another level — even in international play. The road to the World Cup runs through Wemby. France has a captain worth following.

article.headline: France Is 7-1 and Wembanyama Is Locked In — The FIBA World Cup Dream Is Very Real
